artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan landing the stability-quantifier collapse and recurrence-freedom theorems as a new Sharing/Stability.lean, wiring both aggregators, running the full gate set, and handing the (C5) statement to the sibling stability-condition task.

metadata.note: Phase 2 necessarily touches FormalSystem.lean, which is inside concurrent sibling 623's declared file_scope: gate C33 requires the root aggregator to be byte-for-byte `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem` output, so no new module under FormalSystem/ can be landed without it. The plan confines the touch to one generated import line, requires a re-read and git-log territory check immediately beforehand, and requires a STOP-and-report on any foreign change. Phase 4 also corrects this task's recorded file_scope, which currently names the deterministic modules the predecessor's ADD ALONGSIDE constraint forbids editing.
